newsitem.title: USA: American Express signs Tiger Woods.
newsitem.headline: American Express signs Tiger Woods.

text.p: American Express Co. said Monday it has hired 21-year-old golf sensation Tiger Woods as a worldwide spokesman.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Woods, who turned professional last August, won this year's Masters Tournament in April and on Sunday won the Byron Nelson Classic, his first event since the Masters.
The three-time U.S. Amateur champion collected $324,000 for his victory Sunday, pushing his career earnings past the $2 million mark faster than any golfer in history.
American Express said its first commercials featuring Woods will be for American Express Financial Advisors.
Woods, who won the Masters with a record score and record margin of victory, captured two tournaments last fall after turning pro and won the first event of this year on the PGA Tour.
